CustomObject.label: Shop Action
CustomObject.description: A time-boxed Dealer Shop promotion, scoped to one reseller via Administration__c so the same product can carry different, non-conflicting actions per reseller. Products are linked via Shop_Action_Product__c, which carries the per-product additional discount. Read by Ctrl_DealerShop (AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE) to badge/discount products in the shop while today falls within Start_Date__c/End_Date__c.
